items.title: Live: Trump declares 'big money to be made' as US and Iran claim victory over ceasefire deal
items.description: US President ‌Donald Trump says the US will help with "traffic build-up" as the Strait of Hormuz reopens, while Israel disagrees with mediator Pakistan about Lebanon's inclusion in the ceasefire deal. Follow live.

items.title: Donald Trump cedes ground to Iran before negotiations even begin
items.description: By defining the framework set out by Iran as "workable", the US president has ceded ground before negotiations have even begun.

items.title: Trump's rhetoric inappropriate for a US president, Albanese says
items.description: Hours before Donald Trump announced a two-week ceasefire with Iran, the United States president threatened that "a whole civilisation will die tonight, never to be brought back again".

items.title: See the photos from Artemis II's record-breaking Moon mission
items.description: A record-breaking voyage, an earthset in silence, and a total solar eclipse — astronauts on the Artemis II mission experienced sights no human has witnessed in half a century.

items.title: 'The whole industry will fall over': Transport leaders call for urgent action
items.description: An emergency Fair Work Commission hearing in Sydney begins, with unions and employers in the transport industry saying drivers, employees and businesses are on the verge of going under, calling on the top of the supply chain to share the load.

items.title: Ben Roberts-Smith to remain in custody on war crimes charges
items.description: War veteran Ben Roberts-Smith will remain in custody after his lawyers made no application for bail in his first court hearing since his arrest.

items.title: First person charged with 'from the river to the sea' offence faces court
items.description: Liam Parry, 33, was arrested and charged last month for reciting the banned phrase "from the river to the sea."

items.title: Three-day hearing set for Grace Tame abuser over alleged 'menacing' social posts
items.description: Nicolaas Bester, who was previously found guilty of sexually abusing Grace Tame, has been deemed unfit to stand trial over allegations he made "menacing" posts directed at her on social media.

items.title: Family of Veronica Green 'let down' by system during 50 year cold case
items.description: Ms Green was last seen alive on February 13, 1976, with the Coroner's Court of Victoria hearing the litany of policing errors following her disappearance.

items.title: The three reasons behind Penrith's unstoppable start to 2026
items.description: Already, the 2026 premiership looks like it's Penrith's to lose, and there are three big reasons behind the Panthers' record-breaking start to the season.

items.title: Police probe alleged punch that left country footy player with broken jaw
items.description: Victoria Police is investigating an on-field incident during a Good Friday football clash in the Macedon Ranges that left one player with a broken jaw and sparked a melee.

items.title: From 'anger and hate' to feeling 'lighter', Jack is back to being herself
items.description: Shayna Jack says her Paris Olympics campaign was fuelled by "anger and hate", but she is back to being herself — lighter, and with more personal belief than ever.

items.title: Trump and Vance wade into Hungarian election to save far right Orban
items.description: US President Donald Trump has sent his vice-president to Hungary in a bid to salvage the political future of far-right leader Viktor Orbán, who is flailing in the polls days before a closely watched election.

items.title: Driver seriously hurt in truck crash that shut Melbourne freeway for hours
items.description: The crash shutdown outbound lanes of the Princes Freeway at Officer in Melbourne's south-east.

items.title: When is the best time to get your flu vaccine?
items.description: When working out when is the best time to get your vaccine, you might be balancing a theoretical benefit by waiting against a chance of actually getting the flu before you get vaccinated.

items.title: What is financial stress and how does it affect our decisions?
items.description: If financial stress is causing distractions — for example, you're worrying about money when you should be concentrating on driving or work — there might be something deeper happening.

items.title: The Handmaid's Tale's sequel arrives with similarly eerie timing
items.description: The Handmaid's Tale sequel, The Testaments, focuses on young women being groomed for marriage at an elite preparatory school headed by Aunt Lydia in Gilead.

items.title: Smallest town in Australia for sale as two residents decide to sell roadhouse
items.description: Cooladdi, nine hours west of Brisbane, dwindled in population when its railway station closed, but it continues to attract road-trippers and graziers. Its owners run local services including a shop, motel and mail service.

items.title: Former coach says AFL 'shamed' him over $20K fine
items.description: Ex-Port Adelaide coach Ken Hinkley, who was fined for sledging in 2024, says he felt exploited by the league's later use of footage of his theatrics as a promotional tool.

items.title: Parents found guilty of starving daughter win appeal, granted bail
items.description: A Perth man and woman who were found guilty in 2024 of starving their daughter, who weighed about 28 kilograms when she was admitted to hospital aged nearly 17, have their convictions set aside on appeal.

items.title: Rideshare driver accused of rape and stalking multiple women
items.description: A Brisbane rideshare driver had been charged with rape, stalking and coercive control over incidents involving three women across the city over the span of five years.

items.title: Council plan to rename Homebush slammed by residents as 'snob value'
items.description: Some councillors think this area gets confused with Sydney's Olympic precinct and should be renamed. But the plan using the neighbouring suburb's name has rankled some in the community.

items.title: Where cattle once roamed, conservation now grows — and so do concerns
items.description: Hailed as a win for the environment, $200 million has been spent purchasing new national parks in outback NSW — but not everyone is celebrating.

items.title: Amid 'unprecedented' times, farmers take 'risky' gamble on early winter crops
items.description: Some SA farmers have rolled the dice on planting winter crops weeks earlier than usual thanks to record-breaking rains. Now they hope the gamble pays off.

items.title: Farmers angered by plans to turn coal mine into lake bigger than Sydney Harbour
items.description: There are plans to turn the former Hazelwood coal mine in Victoria into a lake bigger than Sydney Harbour, but farmers and environmentalists are worried about the impact on nearby waterways.
